synthetic_notice: This prior pack (v2) contains synthetic aggregate statistics modeled on the shape of public ClinicalTrials.gov/AACT aggregate distributions. No real clinical trial data is included. Real statistics require owner-approved ingestion from ClinicalTrials.gov/AACT public aggregates with a source_allowlist entry.
